earnings.title: World Headquarters
highlights: GAAP Diluted EPS of $0.79, up 61% compared to prior year
Adjusted Diluted EPS of $0.80, up 74% compared to prior year
Sales of $10.2 billion, up 65% in U.S. dollars and 37% organically compared to the third quarter of 2025
GAAP and Adjusted Operating Margin of 29.5% and 29.7% , respectively
Operating and Free Cash Flow of $2.1 billion and $1.6 billion , respectively

quotes.text: We are pleased to have closed the third quarter of 2026 with record sales and Adjusted Diluted EPS, both exceeding the high end of our guidance.
quotes.by: Amphenol Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, R

outlook: Headquartered in Michigan, Empire Electronics is expected to generate full-year 2026 sales of approximately $320 million.
Headquartered in Colorado, AdvancedPCB is expected to have full-year 2026 sales of approximately $270 million and will be included in the Harsh Environment Solutions segment post-closing.
Headquartered in Ireland, Dexgreen is expected to generate full-year 2026 sales of approximately $90 million and will be included in the Communications Solutions segment post-closing.
Humanetics Sensors is expected to generate full-year 2026 sales of approximately $70 million and will be included in the Interconnect and Sensor Systems segment post-closing.

items.heading: The Company is exposed to political, economic, military and other risks related to operating in countries outside the United States, and changes in general economic conditions, geopolitical conditions, U.S. and other countries’ trade policies and other factors beyond the Company’s control may adversely impact its business and operating results.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR GLOBAL OPERATIONS

items.heading: The Company and certain of its suppliers and customers have experienced, and may in the future experience, difficulties obtaining certain raw materials and components, and the cost of certain of the Company’s raw materials and components may increase.

Cybersecurity incidents affecting our information technology systems could disrupt business operations or cause the release of highly sensitive confidential or personal information, resulting in adverse impacts to our reputation and operating results and potentially leading to litigation and/or governmental investigations, fines and other penalties.
